yaml:
name: Test Release Trigger

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry-run:
        description: 'Run release workflow in dry-run mode'
        required: false
        default: 'true'
        type: boolean

jobs:
  trigger:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Trigger integrations-core release workflow
        uses: benc-uk/workflow-dispatch@v1
        with:
          workflow: release-trigger.yml
          repo: DataDog/integrations-core
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          inputs: |
            dry-run: ${{ inputs.dry-run }}
          wait-for-completion: true
          wait-timeout-seconds: 3600
          wait-interval-seconds: 30
